verdict.rationale: x402 is a payment protocol, not an automation platform. It does let agents and backends transact unattended: payments need no signups or approvals, agents can hold funds in Agentic Wallets, and batch settlement supports high-frequency agent loops. That makes it a building block for autonomous background workflows rather than a way to set them up. Missing for 10: any way to create, schedule or manage background automations; spend controls or monitoring for unattended runs; hands-on evidence of autonomous background operation.
